# Show-ZbxPage

## SYNOPSIS

Opens an object's page in the Zabbix web frontend.

## SYNTAX

```
Show-ZbxPage [-InputObject] <PSObject> [-Kind <ZabbixPageKind>] [-View <ZabbixPageView>] [-PassThru] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Show-ZbxPage cmdlet opens, in the default browser, the frontend page of each object piped in from a Get-Zbx command, such as a host, a trigger, a problem or a dashboard, or of the objects -Kind and -Id name. -View picks another of the object's pages, such as its latest data, its problems or an item's history graph. The frontend is the API endpoint's folder unless Connect-ZbxServer -FrontendUri named another. -PassThru writes the page's address instead, and where no browser can open, as in an SSH session, the command warns and writes the address.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Open a host's configuration form

```powershell
Get-ZbxHost -Name 'web-01' | Show-ZbxPage
```

The piped host's kind picks the page: on 7.4 and 8.0 the host's edit dialog, on 7.0 its configuration page.

### Example 2: Write the address instead of opening it

```powershell
Get-ZbxHost -Name 'web-01' | Show-ZbxPage -View Latest -PassThru
Get-ZbxHost -Name 'web-01' | Show-ZbxPage -View Problems -PassThru | ForEach-Object AbsoluteUri
```

-PassThru writes the page's Uri: for a link in a report, a ticket or a chat message. -View picks another page of the object; a host has Latest and Problems besides its form.

### Example 3: Open an item's history as a graph

```powershell
Get-ZbxItem -Host 'web-01' -Name 'Requests' | Show-ZbxPage -View Graph
```

An item read without its host is read again by id, so its form opens in the host's or the template's context.

### Example 4: Link an object by its kind and id

```powershell
Show-ZbxPage -Kind Dashboard -Id 1 -PassThru
(Get-ZbxHost -Name 'web-01', 'db-01').HostId | Show-ZbxPage -Kind Host -PassThru
```

Without a record, -Kind and -Id name the object; it is read by id first, for what its page needs.
